The '''Mutations Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked from the [[Crop Analyzer]] {{Coll|DNA Analysis Milestone I}}, {{Coll|DNA Analysis Milestone III}}, and {{Coll|DNA Analysis Milestone V}} with increasing capacity. The '''{{ID|Small Mutations Sack!Small Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|64}} of each item, the '''{{ID|Medium Mutations Sack!Medium Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|256}} of each item, and the '''{{ID|Large Mutations Sack!Large Sack|nolink=y}}''' can hold {{Green|1,024}} of each item.

== Obtaining ==
A '''{{ID|Small Mutations Sack!Small Sack|nolink=y}}''' is given to the player upon reaching {{Coll|DNA Analysis Milestone I}}.
